subject: Private admin access provisioning — SAML attribute & SCIM group mapping discussion
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-financial.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: itops@acme-financial.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding — SAML & provisioning

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached are the SAML metadata and our SCIM schema export from the IdP (Okta). We want to provision a small set of admin users into the private control plane ahead of the cutover and ensure only the right roles map to elevated privileges.

Questions we need your recommendation on:
- Do you prefer to map via SAML groups or SCIM group assignment for Redwood admin roles?
- If SAML groups: which SAML attributes do you need (groups, eduPersonAffiliation, custom attribute)?
- If SCIM: can Redwood consume nested groups/entitlements from our SCIM schema?
- Our compliance team requires an audit trail for role changes — will SCIM delta events be logged and surfaced in the Console audit view?

Please review the attached and propose a mapping template we can sign off on.

Priya Shah
Head of IT Integrations, Acme Financial Services
priya.shah@acme-financial.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: acme_saml_metadata.xml (XML), acme_scim_schema.json (JSON)

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-financial.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding — SAML & provisioning

Hi Priya — thank you, got both attachments. Quick responses up front:

1) We generally recommend SCIM-based provisioning for the initial population and ongoing lifecycle (create/deactivate/attribute sync). It gives a clean source-of-truth for user lifecycle.
2) For short-lived elevated access during rollout, bind a small set of admin roles via SAML group assertions (so you can avoid an immediate SCIM write path).
3) Required SAML attributes: NameID (email), groups (multi-valued), and a custom attribute 'redwood_role' if you want deterministic overrides. eduPersonAffiliation is optional.
4) Our SCIM consumer supports nested group membership (Okta "parent/child" groups) but we canonicalize into flat role assignments in the control plane; we'll include the parent path in audit logs.
5) Delta events are logged and visible in Console > Audit > SCIM. We also emit webhook events to your ops endpoint for provisioning actions.

I'll attach a proposed CSV mapping template and a minimal playbook for the cutover. Marcus, can you confirm the Console names for the admin roles (org_admin, infra_admin, billing_admin) match what we use in the Dedicated/Private control plane?

Next step: Priya — please confirm the small pilot user list (emails) you want provisioned, and whether you want immediate SAML group binding for those users.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Attachments: proposed-role-mapping.csv, redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-financial.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding — SAML & provisioning

Priya — quick confirmation from the Console side: our canonical role slugs are: org_admin, infra_admin, sp_admin, billing_admin, viewer. We'll map Okta groups to those slugs. A few operational notes:

- If you use SCIM to create the user, we set active=false by default until you assign a role.
- For emergency access we support time-bound elevation via a temporary_admin token with TTL and an approval webhook.
- Audit log entries include: actor (email), action (provision/assign/remove), prior_state, after_state, timestamp, and source (SAML|SCIM|Console).

Laura — can you confirm whether our SCIM consumer accepts 'urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User' enterpriseExtension attributes from Okta? We need manager and department fields for RBAC scoping.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Product Manager, Private Deployments
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-financial.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: itops@acme-financial.com, Security Team <sec-team@trust-solutions.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding — SAML & provisioning

Thanks Marcus/Vivek — that all sounds reasonable. A few clarifications from our end:

- Pilot user list attached (10 folks). For the pilot please: provision via SCIM but map two groups via SAML for org_admin and infra_admin.
- We will send the Okta SCIM token to your secure vault (please provide the key reference).
- Compliance asks that role assignment changes be retained for 7 years — are those exportable?

Couple of asks for Redwood: please share the CSV mapping back so we can show it to our InfoSec and Okta admin to set up group pushes. Also would like a short runbook for a rollback (revoke SCIM provisioning + remove SAML assertions) — want to be sure we can revert quickly.

Priya

Attachments: pilot_user_list.csv

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-financial.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment onboarding — SAML & provisioning

Hi Priya — Laura here (Customer Success). A few concrete deliverables and owners to close this out: 

1) Vivek — share the signed-off CSV mapping + sample Okta group push configuration by EOD Wednesday (we attached a draft CSV in the Drive link).
2) Marcus — confirm SCIM enterpriseExtension support and whether the 7-year export will be available from Console (if not, we will provide an archival export format).
3) Jasmine (install lead) — we will coordinate the vault secret ingestion and the temporary_admin approval webhook. Jasmine, please propose two 1-hour windows for the pilot provisioning run.

Rollback plan (high level):
- Step 1: disable Okta group pushes to Redwood (prevents new SAML assertions).
- Step 2: use Console bulk-deprovision tool to set pilot users active=false and remove role assignments (audit entries created).
- Step 3: rotate any temporary_admin tokens and confirm webhook approvals revoked.

Priya — after you confirm the pilot list we will produce the final runbook and a DocuSign approval sheet for the compliance sign-off.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Private Deployments
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
